prompt:
Paint ONE finished frame of a film-like cutscene of our hand-painted point-and-click adventure game 'Posledny zvonec' (Slovakia; eras 1960, 1982, 1995, 2020, 2035). The reference images are numbered in the order they are given: Image 1: place reference: an alpine hotel lounge (type reference) Image 2: character reference: Ocko, the small delivery robot Image 3: character reference: Tamara, 40, the repairwoman Image 4: a finished interior painting from our game; use it only for the painting technique, brushwork, palette and line quality, not for its content

Shot: The lobby of the real Grand Jasna hotel imagined in 2035: an alpine hotel lounge with wood, stone and warm lamps, a small cafe corner with a coffee machine, and Tamara's temporary repair table 'Second Life' with tools, parts in small drawers and a repaired old radio. By the cafe corner, Tamara crouches down to the little delivery robot Ocko and hands it a small folded paper card on which is handwritten exactly: ĎAKUJEM. Ocko's lid is open with a delivered parcel inside, its light eyes curved upward in a happy look. A delivered cardboard box stands on her repair table.

Characters in this frame (briefs of the approved designs): Tamara, a 40-year-old Slovak repairwoman who runs the travelling repair workshop 'Second Life' in June 2035: friendly, practical, unhurried. Wavy dark auburn hair pinned up loosely with a plain clip, a few strands loose, a warm open face with laugh lines, no glasses. She wears a sturdy sand-brown waxed-canvas bib work apron without any logo or text, with a narrow chest pocket that holds a slim steel caliper (a measuring tool) and two lower pockets; under it a plain rust-red short-sleeved T-shirt, dark grey work trousers and sturdy brown leather work shoes. A tiny tattoo of a small cogwheel-shaped dot is on her near forearm. Her hands hang relaxed at her sides. She is a craftswoman, not a barista and not hotel staff. Ordinary near-future clothes (2035), nothing futuristic, no face mask. Ocko, a small friendly autonomous delivery robot (model 2033) waiting on a pavement in June 2035. It is shaped like an upright hard-shell suitcase with generously rounded corners, about knee-to-hip height of an adult, standing on two large dark grey rubber wheels, one on each side at the bottom. The shell is painted a warm cream white with a sunflower-yellow band around the top lid. On its front face is a dark smoked-glass panel with two simple round glowing light eyes in soft pale blue, and below them a small curved row of tiny glowing pale blue dots that looks a little like a smile. On top: a closed parcel lid with a recessed handle; a thin flexible antenna rises from the back corner and carries a small bright orange triangular safety pennant. No arms, no weapons, no sharp edges, no text, no letters, no logos, no number plate. Cute and non-threatening, like a helpful household appliance.

Light and time: Warm lamp light and soft daylight; friendly mood.

Character references show approved characters of the game on a plain grey card: copy each person's face, age, hair, body proportions, clothes and colours exactly, but pose and light them for this scene; never copy the grey card, the sheet layout or a duplicate of the same person. Place references show the real location and its painted version in our game: keep its architecture, materials and era. Photos are only references: repaint everything in our style, paint any real people in them out, and do not copy brand logos or shop names. Composition: a calm 16:9 picture like a still from the last minutes of a film, with a clear focal point and depth; it is shown whole with a caption below it, so keep the subject well inside the frame. One single image: no panels, no split screen, no border, no frame, no captions, no subtitles, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no UI, unless the shot asks for it. No text or lettering anywhere unless the shot quotes it exactly.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
